title: Huge dark room with weird grey creature
content: When I was a kid, I used to dream of being in a mall, and I was in a bookstore that was on the second floor, and then we’d have to go to a phone store which was on the first floor. but on the way to the store, we enter a large room of pure darkness where a weird grey creature would chase us. It was TERRIFYING, and I’ve dreamt the exact same dream multiple times, knowing how it’s always going to end. The creature is the scariest thing I’ve ever seen. I’ve never dreamt of the creature outside of the mall, so it’s like it resides there, specifically in that room. I’m new to this whole mall world thing, so has anyone else dreamt of the dark room with the weird grey creature within the mall?
